facts: The workers’ association opened the stone hall at Hämeenpuisto 28 in 1900.
The corner at Hämeenpuisto and Hallituskatu was raised from five to eight storeys. The hall was extended in several stages.

record: Pirkanmaa Regional Museum protected building review
facts: All parts of the protected hall were built in stages between 1900 and 1992. The two primary frontages face Hämeenpuisto and Hallituskatu.

record: City of Tampere register of buildings
facts: Native building 14527 and height parts for national building ID 103403590N record an eight-storey building and the maximum roof elevation of 124.5 m.
